question.text: Per SEBI, the 'Material Deviation' threshold for investment approach (requires client notification) is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Material deviation = beyond the risk-bucket / style boundary defined in the IA. Client notification + disclosure required. The Trap: Routine rebalancing is not material; style drift is. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B depth. Manager's Pro-Tip: Define 'material' in the IA document so boundaries are unambiguous — avoids disputes.
